chapter: Tatum, Wiggins and Los Angeles friends
title: Jimmy Talbert becomes an attorney
summary: Callender recounts a legal bill that sparked Talbert's interest in law and praises his help.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Speaking of Jimmy Talbert, I've known him since he was...I guess he was still a teenager. Anyhow, our lives

have always seemed to cross, because of my relationship to his uncle to begin with. But the reason for Jimmy's being an attorney, which he may or may not have told you, was one day I had to go take care of some business with an attorney who happened to be Felicia Sanders' husband, who... I'll talk about her later. But anyhow, Jimmy went with me, and when... I guess I spent about a half-hour with... I don't remember the attorney's name. But anyhow, my bill was fifty bucks. So Jimmy said, 'My God, is that the kind of money attorneys make?' Well, the rest is history. He is now an attorney, and this was the spark that triggered it his interest in law.
Well, he had to be a good attorney. Because Jimmy Talbert was probably the most persuasive person who ever lived. I mean, he could talk anybody into anything.

I have to agree with you. And he has saved my son's...I won't say saved his life, but he's kept him out of jail many times. Just for stupid things that my son has done, like getting traffic tickets and thinking they'd go away -- and stupid stuff. Anyhow...
Yeah, Jimmy is an amazing person.
Well, I love him. He's been beautiful, and he's one of my very favorite people.
